#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=voting-qwen3_1.7b-multi_lora-deepcoder_primeintellect
#SBATCH --output=logs/%j_%x.out
#SBATCH --error=logs/%j_%x.err
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:2
#SBATCH --cpus-per-gpu=16
#SBATCH --mem-per-gpu=64G
#SBATCH --partition=preempt
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --constraint=l40s
#SBATCH --requeue
#SBATCH --time=0-05:50:00
# Rendered by scripts/launch.py from scripts/slurm/train.sbatch.tmpl.
# Re-submitting the same command resumes from the latest checkpoint of the experiment directory;
# a finished run prints "RUN_COMPLETE global_step=N" and exits 0.

unset ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES
cd <REPO>
source scripts/env.sh
set -x
ulimit -n 1048576

export RAY_TMPDIR=/tmp/ray_${USER}
export VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF="expandable_segments:False"
export VLLM_USE_V1=1
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S=100000000000
export VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING=True
export VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=INFO
export VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL=INFO

python -m marl_workflows.trainer.train \
    marl.task=deepcoder \
    marl.workflow=voting \
    data.max_prompt_length=10240 \
    data.max_response_length=2048 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path=Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B \
    trainer.project_name=marl-llm-workflows \
    trainer.experiment_name=voting-qwen3_1.7b-multi_lora-deepcoder_primeintellect \
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node=2 \
    'trainer.agent_names=[generator,aggregator]' \
    trainer.share_policy=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=23554 \
    +rllm.workflow.n_votes=3 \
    rllm.workflow.use_final_outcome_reward=true \
    rllm.workflow.code_executor_workers=32 \
    +data.dataset_name=deepcoder_primeintellect
